summary: Prepare a fresh testnet-v1 network with isolated MinerPass V2 rules
details: Freeze chain ID and network ID 202610030, a distinct genesis header, and an independent BTC-mainnet registry scope.
Preserve reviewed genesis allocations, contract code, PoW settings and reusable signed Bitcoin snapshot inputs.
Select Candidate and Publish bundles by release generation and reject mismatched tags, registries and bundle identities.
Go recognizes the explicitly selected testnet-v1 registry; genesis generation rebuilds chain-bound system storage, and fast CI checks Rust and Go artifacts together.
operator_actions: After the v1 release is published, stop the v0 runtime and initialize the new USDB network from block zero using the v1 installer and isolated state paths.
Preserve wallet and signer material; do not copy v0 indexer, chain or runtime SourceDAO state into v1. Reuse Bitcoin data only under the validated compatibility contract.
Complete SourceDAO bootstrap again, verify a new MinerPass V2 inscription, and validate upgraded Seed connectivity before mining.
